definition: The group of words for the ranks of the style taxonomy, from a tradition down to a buildable variant.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`rank` holds the ranks of the style taxonomy, from a tradition down to a buildable variant", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
